fields.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kalista's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Rend'' to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 254 times per enemy.
fields.description2:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' rips out the lodged spears from all nearby enemies afflicted with ''Rend'' stacks, consuming the stacks on each target to deal {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow}} them for 2 seconds. For each stack beyond the first, the target is dealt additional {{as|physical damage}}. ''Rend'' deals 50% damage against epic {{tip|monsters}}.

''Rend's'' cast also empowers the in-flight missiles of '''Kalista's''' basic attacks and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' to apply ''Rend's'' effects to their targets immediately upon hitting them.
fields.description3: If ''Rend'' kills at least one target, its {{sti|cooldown}} is reset and '''Kalista''' restores {{sti|{{as|mana}}}}.
fields.description4: ''A nearby enemy with a Rend stack is required to cast this ability.''
fields.notes:
* ''Rend'' cannot activate on {{tip|untargetable}} enemies.
* ''Rend'' applies its effects instantly on cast.
* ''Rend'' can be used during the dash of {{ai|Martial Poise|Kalista}}, and during the cast time of {{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}. If ''Rend'' is used during the cast time of {{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}, before the projectile spawns, doing so will repeat the first-spear damage to a target already damaged by ''Rend'', {{bug|2}} in addition to empowering the projectile with ''Rend's'' effects.
* The cooldown will not reset if the target is protected by {{tip|resurrection}} effects.
* If ''Rend'' is used against {{ci|Sion}} under the effects of {{ai|Glory in Death|Sion}}, the cooldown will reset even if it does not kill him.{{bug}}
* A stack is not applied if the attack is {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}} or missed while '''Kalista''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
* {{ai|Pierce|Kalista}} does not apply a stack of ''Rend'' if blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}.
* While {{ai|Hostile Takeover|Renata Glasc|berserk}}, '''Kalista's''' attacks will also apply ''Rend'' stacks on allies.
** '''Kalista''' will be unable to cast ''Rend'' if there are no stacks on an enemy in range.
*** ''Rend'' cannot cast on allies, even if a valid enemy target exists. As such, any spears on allied units are purely cosmetic.
* ''Rend'' has a lower cast range than effect range.
* ''Rend'' at maximum stacks will deal a total of {{as|{{ap|({{#var:b1a}} to {{#var:b5a}})+({{#var:b1b}} to {{#var:b5b}})*253}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad}}+({{#var:ad1b}} to {{#var:ad5b}})*253}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:{{#var:ap}}+{{#var:aps}}*253}}% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}}.
}}
